resale_co.name: Residential Re-Sale Inspection (property maintenance certificate)
resale_co.issued_by: Shamong Township Construction Office (Building Code, Construction Permits & Zoning)
resale_co.lead_time: Give 14 days notice when scheduling the inspection
resale_co.valid_for: If the ownership change does not happen within six months, a new application is required
requirements: Smoke alarm on each floor, including the basement (not unfinished attic or crawl space)
Smoke and carbon monoxide alarm within 10 feet of all bedrooms
House numbers on the front of the house or end of the driveway, at least 3 inches, lighted or reflective
Reflective house numbers on both sides of the mailbox
Pool and hot tub enclosures up to code
Steps and railings stable and secure
Chimney caps and spark arrestor installed
Visible, mounted 2A10BC fire extinguisher in the kitchen (January 2024 form)
All construction permits closed before the inspection is completed

fees.label: Residential re-sale inspection
fees.quote: The fee for said inspection will be $50.00.

fees.label: Re-inspection
fees.quote: If a re-inspection is required an additional fee of $25.00 will be collected.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Download the Residential Re-Sale Inspection form from the Building Code, Construction Permits & Zoning page. Send it with a check payable to Township of Shamong to the Construction Office, 105 Willow Grove Road, Shamong, NJ 08088, and give 14 days notice when scheduling. Questions and inspection requests go to inspections@shamong.net. The certificate can be delivered by email, mail or pick-up.

evidence.quote: A check made payable to Township of Shamong must accompany this form.
If the ownership change is not made within six months a new application shall be required.
WHEN SCHEDULING AN INSPECTION, A 14 DAY NOTICE MUST BE GIVEN.
A property maintenance certificate will only be issued when the premises inspected are consistent with Shamong Township’s Land Use and Property Maintenance Codes.
All construction permits must be closed prior to the inspection being completed.
Ed Toussaint / etoussaint@shamong.net Construction Code, Zoning Official

resale_co.notes: The township publishes a Residential Re-Sale Inspection form and lists a Construction Permit/Resale Inspector, but no page or ordinance text seen says in so many words that every sale needs it; the ordinance (ecode360 SH2016) could not be opened. Because the same inspection covers smoke alarms, CO alarms and the extinguisher, and the state directory names the Shamong Construction Office for smoke detector compliance, it is treated as required at resale. The Construction Code/Zoning Official is Ed Toussaint (etoussaint@shamong.net). The page gives the office line as (609) 268-2377 option 4 (also x305); the form lists office hours M-F 8:30AM-11:30AM while the web page lists secretary hours Monday-Thursday 9:00AM-12:00PM.

requirements: Smoke alarm on each floor, including the basement
Smoke and CO alarm within 10 feet of all bedrooms
Visible, mounted 2A10BC fire extinguisher in the kitchen (January 2024 township form still lists it)

authorities.name: Shamong Township Construction Office (designated for smoke detector compliance; NJ DCA is the fire code enforcing agency)
authorities.how_to_apply: Smoke alarms, CO alarms and the extinguisher are checked during the Residential Re-Sale Inspection ($50, see the resale certificate section). No separate smoke certificate form or fee was found. Email inspections@shamong.net.

evidence.quote: LEAID: 0332-999 Enf Auth. State Fire Official Louis Kilmer Phone (609)633-6132
SMOKE DETECTOR COMPLIANCE Name:Shamong Twp Constr Office Addr: 105 Willow Grove Rd Shamong NJ 08088 Phone (609) 268-2372
Smoke detector on each floor, including basement, excluding unfinished attic or crawl space.
Visible fire extinguisher in kitchen 2A10BC (must be mounted)

fire_cert.notes: The NJ DCA is the fire code enforcing agency for Shamong (LEA registry code S). The DCA state-towns list (revised 7/17/2026) lists Shamong without the "SC" (smoke certs) flag, and the state directory names the Shamong Twp Construction Office, 105 Willow Grove Rd, (609) 268-2372, for smoke detector compliance. The directory phone (609) 268-2372 differs from the township office number 609-268-2377 used on the form and web page. The township page links the DCA "Smoke Alarm/Carbon Monixide Compliance" information sheet and says to call the Construction Office at 609-268-2377 x305 for specific requirements.

other_items.label: All construction permits closed
other_items.detail: All construction permits must be closed before the resale inspection can be completed.

other_items.label: Buyer purchasing "as is"
other_items.detail: If the buyer is purchasing the property as is, the township needs a notarized letter saying so; no certificate is issued without it.
